name: Cache of Zanzil's Altered Mixture
summary: At the Venture Company tower near the Sludge Fen, a cache of Zanzil's Altered Mixture lies locked away. The potent poison bears the name of Zanzil, a jungle troll witch doctor.

sections.title: A Toxic Enterprise
sections.body: North of the Sludge Fen in the Barrens, the Venture Company holds a tower outpost. Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix keeps a cache of altered mixture bearing the name of the troll witch doctor Zanzil in his private strongbox at the summit. A poison has weakened everyone in the tower, leaving its goblin inhabitants vulnerable to a bold intruder.

sections.title: Recovery for the Shattered Hand
sections.body: The Shattered Hand is a secretive rogue guild beneath Orgrimmar. Master trainer Shenthul sends operatives to storm the tower, kill Gallywix and break open his lockbox. The guild seeks to neutralize the threat and study the mixture for its own intelligence work. Recovering the volatile cache calls for strong infiltration skills. Its contaminated container can expose whoever handles it to debilitating toxins.

faq.answer: Zanzil's Altered Mixture is a potent poison named for the troll witch doctor Zanzil. A cache lies locked in the Venture Company tower near the Sludge Fen, where poison has weakened everyone inside.
The cache is in Gallywix's Lockbox at the top of the Venture Company tower, north of the Sludge Fen in the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does the Shattered Hand want the mixture?
faq.answer: Shenthul and the Shattered Hand seek to neutralize the Venture Company operation on the Horde's doorstep and recover the compound for their own intelligence studies.

faq.q: How do you open the chest containing the cache?
faq.answer: The chest has delicate tumbler locks that call for advanced lockpicking skill. Its contaminated container can expose its handler to debilitating toxins.

angles.text: For Horde rogues, retrieving the mixture is a rite of passage. It proves mastery of lockpicking, pickpocketing and poison handling in service to the Shattered Hand.
The Venture Company's poison-laden tower north of the Sludge Fen threatens the surroundings and security of both Durotar and the Barrens.
